title: Length of the search bits
statement: Let $D$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits indexed by natural numbers, where the circuit at index $j$ has $n+j$ inputs. For every Boolean list $y$ and natural number $j$, the list of search bits constructed from $y$ using the first $j$ circuits has length $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A family $D$ with a circuit on $n+j$ inputs for each natural number $j$
